facts.claim: Fail-closed switch: "failClosed": true on a handler (fail_closed also read; Claude-style "onFailure": "block" also read). Exists in 1.0.71 and 1.0.73, NOT in 1.0.70, the current npm latest. Only PreToolUse and UserPromptSubmit honor it; with it a timeout, crash, spawn failure, unparseable '{' reply or unknown decision denies; plain non-JSON stdout on exit 0 still allows

facts.claim: Reply: top-level decision allow|deny|ask|defer (+reason) or hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision (+permissionDecisionReason), the latter wins; legacy approve/block accepted; allow does not auto-approve; ask forces the permission prompt; defer = no opinion; updatedInput replaces the input (non-object fails the hook; schema failure blocks); additionalContext goes to the model
facts.source: npm:@xai-official/grok-linux-x64@1.0.71 bin/grok.br (brotli) embedded 10-hooks.md, line numbers are lines of 'strings -n 8' output:30240-30270

facts.claim: Exit codes: 0 allow unless JSON says otherwise; 2 deny (unless stdout JSON says continue:false, which stops the agent); other codes fail open but a JSON deny or continue:false on stdout is honored at any exit code; a non-zero exit drops updatedInput and additionalContext
facts.source: npm:@xai-official/grok-linux-x64@1.0.71 bin/grok.br (brotli) embedded 10-hooks.md, line numbers are lines of 'strings -n 8' output:30298-30304

facts.claim: Without failClosed, timeouts, crashes and malformed output fail open; exceptions that block: reply past 8 MiB read limit, updatedInput nested past 124 levels or failing the tool schema

facts.claim: continue:false (+stopReason) ends the turn (the agent stops; queued prompts wait for the user) instead of just denying the call
